context.title: Project Model View
context.description: Shows the project's schema (the CIM and any extensions) as a tree of packages, classes and members. It follows your selection in the Project Explorer and the Profile Editor.

context.title: Documentation View
context.description: Shows the schema documentation for the class or property selected in the Project Model, the Project Explorer or the Profile Editor.

context.title: Profile Preview View
context.description: Shows a live PlantUML diagram of the profile in the active Profile Editor, redrawn each time the profile is saved. The diagram style should match the profile's target.

topic.label: The Profile Preview and Your Target

context.title: Validation Projects View
context.description: Lists the CIM/XML files imported for validation and the results of validating them against a profile.

context.title: Profile Editor
context.description: Edits a profile. Select an element in the Outline view, then use the tabs along the bottom of the editor to work on it. Saving the profile runs the builders selected on the Profile Summary tab.

context.title: Add/Remove Tab
context.description: Chooses which classes, attributes and associations from the schema are in the profile. What the tab offers depends on the element selected in the Outline view.

context.title: Restriction Tab
context.description: Restricts the selected class or property: cardinality, concrete and descriptor classes, By Reference, the parent class and the property's type.

context.title: Documentation Tab
context.description: Writes full documentation for the selected profile element in AsciiDoc.

context.title: Description Tab
context.description: Shows the schema's description of the selected element and holds the profile's own description of it.

context.title: Stereotypes Tab
context.description: Applies stereotypes to the selected profile element.

context.title: Profile Summary Tab
context.description: Sets the profile's namespace and chooses which builders generate artifacts from the profile when it is saved.

topic.label: How the Builders Reflect the Target
